{{Quote|You will face justice for killing Jesef.|Obi-Wan Kenobi warns T'mott Zoat about the consequences for his crime|<ref name="SC" />}}
'''Jesef''' was an individual who the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was assigned to protect while he was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Kenobi failed in his assignment and the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] criminal [[T'mott Zoat]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] her on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Helleguth]]<ref name="SC" /> around [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]].<ref name="SCt" /> After her death, the Jedi swore he would single-handedly capture Zoat and bring him to justice. Kenobi did capture Zoat, although with the aid of his friends, twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after Jesef's death.<ref name="SC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jesef was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]'', a digest sized [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Justin Aclin]].<ref name="SC" />
